name: aromir_e2e_vinylfuran
purpose: TASKS 245 item (3), 16 Nov 2026: `aromir spectrum` end to end on a molecule with a soft mode, so that the soft-mode repair runs inside the rebuilt pipeline (aromir cb01c7c) with real quantum chemistry. 3-vinylfuran, C=Cc1ccoc1, 13 atoms: the smallest corpus molecule whose analytic B3LYP label has a mode below 20 cm-1 (B_1e0fa2d7f0: -11.67 analytic, -11.95 measured, probes/results_m1/aromir_e2e_2026-11-16/pick_soft_mode_molecule.log). The corpus label stays imaginary after the repair, so the run may also step off a saddle point and optimise a second time. To be read against the corpus's repaired label and the corpus Hessian's B3LYP positions. In WSL from ~/aromir_dev (the code of ~/aromir-src at cb01c7c; pyscf 2.15.0), capped by probes/wsl_capped.sh beside the live training.
command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -e bash -c "export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONUTF8=1 PYSCF_TMPDIR=/home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp TMPDIR=/home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp; mkdir -p /home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp; cd /mnt/c/Users/thebr/Documents/CapstonePlan/plans/05_delta-probed-ir-pipeline && echo '=== (AROMIR) start' && bash probes/wsl_capped.sh 4096 -- /usr/bin/time -f '(AROMIR) max RSS %M kB, wall %e s' /home/thebreadishard/aromir_dev/bin/aromir spectrum 'C=Cc1ccoc1' --out probes/results_m1/aromir_e2e_2026-11-16/vinylfuran --threads 8 --max-memory-mb 2048; echo \"=== (AROMIR) done: vinylfuran, exit $?\""

estimate.basis: benzene (12 atoms, 102 basis functions) took 559 s end to end on 16 Nov with aromir cb01c7c on 8 threads beside the training (aromir_benzene_cb01c7c); 3-vinylfuran has 111 basis functions and no symmetry, the repair adds two gradients per soft mode, and a step off a saddle point runs the optimisation and the Hessian a second time

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run at 4096 MB (pyscf max_memory 2048); benzene peaked at 1.89 GB
